_comment: V27 typography, read off Figma nodes rather than exported.
Figma text styles are not variables, so no type collection exists in variables.json
(FINDINGS.md #1). V27 also publishes no text styles to its library - the styles below
are LOCAL to the file, which is why they appear in neither the variables export nor a
library style search. They are therefore transcribed here BY HAND, and every entry
carries the node ids it was measured on so it can be re-checked.
This file is the only hand-maintained source in the token layer. It is a stated gap,
not a hidden one: when V27 promotes type to variables, delete this file and let
lineHeight: Figma reports its AUTO line height as the number 100. It does NOT mean
100px and it does not mean 100% - Figma's own code generator emits `leading-[normal]`
for it, so it maps to CSS `normal`. A style with a real numeric line height reports it

fontFamily.note: Not licensed and not bundled - see FINDINGS.md #9. The library renders in the fallback unless the consuming app loads Outfit itself.

sm.note: The workhorse. Tag label, field label, link, header sub text.

lg-bold.note: Header display title. Figma reports lineHeight 100 = AUTO.

sm-bold.note: Measured on every Button variant, which reports Outfit SemiBold 14 / 600 / AUTO. Figma did not report a STYLE NAME for it, so the name here is this library's, not Figma's.

unverified.note: The style guide (node 1:27) has a Typography frame naming XL Heading, Larger Heading and Sub heading. Node 1:27 exceeds the metadata ceiling (FINDINGS.md #11) so those three could not be read off their nodes, and they are deliberately NOT emitted. A guessed heading scale is worse than a missing one.
